notes: Employee schedule only; board remuneration, supplier payments, severance schedules and financial-statement aggregates are excluded. No job titles are supplied in the employee table.
Source names, separate repeated-name records, exact displayed cents, negative expenses and missing dash cells are retained. A disclosed name is not a verified unique identity.
Displayed named remuneration differs from the printed subtotal by $54; expenses differ by $93. Individual amounts remain unchanged and exact reconciliation is not claimed.
The scope page includes salaries, wages, retroactive pay, vacation payouts, taxable benefits and retiring allowances; amounts paid under severance agreements are explicitly excluded.

Remuneration is the sum of the source's numeric retainers, meeting fees and any separately disclosed travel per-diem fees. Its expense-inclusive annual total is supporting evidence, not remuneration. Unfilled retainer-role columns are not additional pay observations.
Names retain the source spelling; adjacent footnote markers are separately preserved in row provenance.
Source footnotes may describe payments for meetings or travel from earlier years; observations retain the internally stated payment disclosure year.

All printed named observations are retained in original document order, including repeated source observations. Names are disclosed strings, not resolved identities. Only source whitespace and comma spacing are standardized; Providence visibly separate surname/given-name columns are joined with a comma.
The source publishes no job title for these employee observations; position remains null.
